variable.name: population count
variable.referenceDate: 2025 (national totals aligned to UN WPP 2024 January 1st estimates)

semantics: Modelled residential population (Random Forest dasymetric redistribution of census/estimate totals), constrained to mapped settlement/building pixels; unsettled land is nodata, not zero. Not a census, not real-time, not daytime/ambient population. Alpha (R2025A) product that may change. Uncertainty grows for years further from census input timepoints.
alternatives: Same directory tree also has 1km_ua/constrained/global_pop_2025_CN_1km_R2025A_UA_v1.tif (289,502,513 B), which is the file the hub record id=80031 links to. Not downloaded. Do not sum WorldPop with GHSL (CTX-05) population; choose one per metric.

derived.h3: data/prepared/worldpop_2025_1km_h3r6.parquet via scripts/aggregate_raster_to_h3.py --agg sum (pixel-centre assignment to H3 res 6; columns h3 uint64, value float32 persons, n_valid). Cells with no valid pixel are absent (unknown/unsettled), never zero-filled.
